entries.title: Exodus 23:1
segments: ¶Thou shalt not accept a false report; extend not thy hand to the wicked, to be an unrighteous witness.

entries.title: Exodus 23:2
segments: Thou shalt not follow the multitude for evil; neither shalt thou answer in a cause, to go after the multitude to pervert [judgment].

entries.title: Exodus 23:3
segments: Neither shalt thou favour a poor man in his cause.

entries.title: Exodus 23:4
segments: --If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt certainly bring it back to him.

entries.title: Exodus 23:5
segments: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under its burden, beware of leaving [it] to him: thou shalt certainly loosen [it] with him.

entries.title: Exodus 23:6
segments: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

entries.title: Exodus 23:7
segments: Thou shalt keep far from the cause of falsehood; and the innocent and righteous slay not; for I will not justify the wicked.

entries.title: Exodus 23:8
segments: And thou shalt take no bribe; for the bribe blindeth those whose eyes are open, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

entries.title: Exodus 23:9
segments: And the stranger thou shalt not oppress; for ye know the spirit of the stranger, for ye have been strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 23:10
segments: ¶And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and gather in its produce;

entries.title: Exodus 23:11
segments: but in the seventh thou shalt let it rest and lie [fallow], that the poor of thy people may eat [of it]; and what they leave, the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thine olive-tree.

entries.title: Exodus 23:12
segments: --Six days thou shalt do thy work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger may be refreshed.

entries.title: Exodus 23:13
segments: And ye shall be on your guard as to everything that I have said unto you; and shall make no mention of the name of other gods--it shall not be heard in thy mouth.

entries.title: Exodus 23:14
segments: Thrice in the year thou shalt celebrate a feast to me.

entries.title: Exodus 23:15
segments: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread, (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I have commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt; and none shall appear in my presence empty;)

entries.title: Exodus 23:16
segments: and the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labours which thou hast sown in the field, and the feast of in-gathering, at the end of the year, when thou gatherest in thy labours out of the field.

entries.title: Exodus 23:17
segments: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear in the presence of the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Exodus 23:18
segments: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my feast remain all night until the morning.

entries.title: Exodus 23:19
segments: The first of the first-fruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of Jehovah thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

entries.title: Exodus 23:20
segments: ¶Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee to the place that I have prepared.

entries.title: Exodus 23:21
segments: Be careful in his presence, and hearken unto his voice: do not provoke him, for he will not forgive your transgressions; for my name is in him.

entries.title: Exodus 23:22
segments: But if thou shalt diligently hearken unto his voice, and do all that I shall say, then I will be an enemy to thine enemies, and an adversary to thine adversaries.

entries.title: Exodus 23:23
segments: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.

entries.title: Exodus 23:24
segments: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their deeds; but thou shalt utterly destroy them, and utterly shatter their statues.

entries.title: Exodus 23:25
segments: And ye shall serve Jehovah your God; and he shall bless thy bread and thy water; and I will take sickness away from thy midst.

entries.title: Exodus 23:26
segments: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land; the number of thy days will I fulfil.

entries.title: Exodus 23:27
segments: I will send my fear before thee, and confound every people to which thou comest, and will make all thine enemies turn their back to thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:28
segments: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:29
segments: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year: lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:30
segments: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou art fruitful, and possess the land.

entries.title: Exodus 23:31
segments: And I will set thy bounds from the Red Sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness unto the river; for I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hand, that thou mayest dispossess them from before thee.

entries.title: Exodus 23:32
segments: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

entries.title: Exodus 23:33
segments: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me; for if thou serve their gods, it is sure to be a snare unto thee.
